text:
Compound Z contains carbon, hydrogen and oxygen.
Molecules of compound Z have four hydrogen atoms and two carbon atoms.
Compound Z can be made by oxidation of an alcohol.
What is compound Z?
A
ethene
B
ethanol
C
ethanoic acid
D
methyl methanoate
subject: Chemistry
